Hell Spheres are a type of Elemental creature in Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Two Hell Spheres are summoned when the party trigger the alarm within the House of Hope; they accost the party until defeated.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Ram ()
Damage: 6~36
6d6⁠Fire
Slam into an enemy creature or object. On a successful save, the target still takes half damage.
 DEX Save
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)

Tactics

  • ⁠Force, ⁠Thunder, and ⁠Cold attacks are particularly useful against the Hell Spheres, being the only three categories of damage they do not have any resistance to.
  • Since Hell Spheres do not make Opportunity Attacks, party members and allies can freely back away after making melee attacks, in order to avoid the effects of the  Hellish Sphere condition.
  • Hell Spheres are immune to certain conditions and spells including  Frightened,  Prone,  Stunned,  Command,  Hold Monster,  Banishment,  Evard's Black Tentacles,  Hideous Laughter,  Cursed: Dread,  Phantasmal Killer.
  •  Otto's Irresistible Dance and  Planar Binding do work against Hell Spheres.
  •  Telekinesis is effective.
  • Immune to Petrification but  Flesh to Stone restrains them for 3 turns.

Notes

  • Grant 400 experience each when killed.
